body:
Progresses #446 (the cold free-start / ultimate start solver). All changes land on `dev` and pass the full gate suite.

## What this does

- **GateFoldFinder (new)** — cold-solves the momentum **gate-pattern basins** for dF/no-turn chains that continuous search cannot reach across the `|v|<0.005` gate discontinuity. It enumerates the few near-threshold gate bits, runs a gate-steered SLP whose merit rewards gate-satisfaction (so a step can *cross* the discontinuity), byte-exact lattice-polishes, and seeds via a threshold homotopy. Wired into `CertifiedBnb` for foldable-dF specs in both FIRST_FEASIBLE and OPTIMIZE, adopting only byte-exact-feasible, objective-better incumbents (monotone, so nothing regresses).
- **Lattice-exact certified core** — integer-LUT-index branch intervals, disjoint index splits, lattice-rep decode, and an exact lattice leaf. Removes sub-lattice angle waste (the search no longer refines angles below the ~0.0055-degree realizable step).
- **Honest certified dual gap** — the printed "Dual bound gap" is now bound to the incumbent that earned it (carry-on-candidate), fixing the misattributed/negative report from #446. The certified bound itself was already sound; the bug was reporting.
- **Free-start stability gate + horizon budget/deadline** — pins gh386-4x2b seed independence and stops the certified node starving.
- **Benchmark harness** — `HpkStartBenchmark` over the d10/d11/d12 human captures reports per-jump solve, objective vs reference, and wall-clock.

## Results (cold THOROUGH, gap>0 = short of the human reference; negative = beats it)

| bucket | jumps |
| --- | --- |
| meet / beat (<=1e-5) | j155 (0), j828 (-7.3e-6), j716 (-3.0e-5), j718 (-6.1e-4) |
| short, right basin | j154 (+8.1e-5), j925 (+2.1e-4), j1150 (+3.4e-4), j1149 (+1.7e-3), j140 (+2.85e-3), j345 (+6.5e-3) |
| hard (byte-exact wall in the reached basin) | j1099 (+0.658) |
| unsolved | j335 (16/28) |

Previously-unsolved j345/j1099/j716 now solve; the p2s dF free-start now solves 44/44.

## Tests / gates (all green)

`CertBnbDfFoldTest` (p2s 44/44), `FreeStartStabilityTest` (seed independence), `PipelineShapeTest`, `DfChainTiesTest`, `CertifiedBnbEngineTest` (4/4; the dF-chain decline case rewritten to the now-converging behavior), `GapAttributionTest`, `ProblemsTest`, and the fast suite. `tableStyleCheck` green.

## Known-open (honest)

- The small "beats" (j716/j718/j828) commit through a `translated start`; byte-exact `viol <= 0` is independently confirmed only for j155/j1150 so far (j1150 shows a 3.24e-5 sub-lattice violation on a similar path). Worth a dedicated viol check before calling those three strictly clean.
- j1099 reaches the human basin *direction* but a ~1.69-block byte-exact wall; j335 stalls at viol ~0.16. These are genuine algorithmic walls, not tuning gaps.
title: feat(anglesolver): cold gate-pattern start solver + lattice-exact certified core
